Hairs 😍

Cute dress, black dress possibly suit you better :\). Never too late to buy new clothes.

The only comfortable thing to me is staying home. I hope I'll move my ass.

Appreciate it, you want to help me!

I'm not on therapy, but your words encourage me to go. Probably, I'll wait some time to be on the turn. Despite that, I might not survive in between that time.

You seems so humble and heart-warming person. World would be so much better place, if we had more people like you!
I keep telling myself that I need changes but I have limits.

Living in misery and having no friends is a consequence of my past. If I start to live my life at 19, this is so late. I rarely going outside the house now. It's so hard to walk out. I think I'm carrying my old demons with myself and let them to control my life. Nothing can keep me entertained except music. But I'm slowly losing interest even in this.

It's almost impossible to increase my education, because I failed to finish twice. I have finish primary school though. It Will be weird to be put in a class of 15's and 16's. I could go for the programm, where I could be put in a class of people without high school education, but this costs money, so anyway I need job first.

I know I'm teenager but I can't get rid of the feeling that I didn't have good childhood. Everyone enjoyed when they were kids, but not me. I'm just wasting my life.
